senses.en: to deal with a problem or issue
senses.pattern: address a problem / address an issue / address concerns
senses.example: The school hired two more counselors to [[address]] the growing problem of stress among students.
senses.example_zh: 學校多聘了兩位輔導老師，以處理學生壓力日益嚴重的問題。

senses.en: a formal speech given to an audience
senses.pattern: deliver an address / an opening address / a commencement address
senses.example: The principal's opening [[address]] at the graduation ceremony lasted only five minutes but moved everyone.
senses.example_zh: 校長在畢業典禮上的開場致詞只有五分鐘，卻感動了所有人。
senses.note: 亦作動詞：address the audience 向聽眾演說

gsat.sentence: It was not until Grover Cleveland’s first presidency that some effective crowd control measures were implemented to [[address]] the problem caused by this practice.
The speaker was Robot Redford, a robot who delivered the commencement [[address]] at a community college in suburban Maryland.

senses.en: seeming to be real or true, but possibly not
senses.pattern: an apparent contradiction / apparent calm / an apparent lack of interest
senses.example: Her [[apparent]] confidence on stage hid the fact that her hands were shaking badly.
senses.example_zh: 她在台上那份表面上的自信，掩蓋了她雙手抖個不停的事實。
senses.note: 副詞 apparently 意為「看來、似乎」

senses.en: (of a person) free to meet or talk to someone
senses.pattern: be available for a meeting / be available to help / be available on Friday
senses.example: Dr. Lin is [[available]] on Friday afternoon if you would like to discuss your test results.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想討論檢驗結果，林醫師星期五下午有空。

gsat.sentence: The bank tries its best to attract more customers. Its staff members are always [[available]] to provide prompt service.

senses.en: not good enough for someone's position or dignity
senses.pattern: beneath sb / beneath one's dignity / consider sth beneath you
senses.example: The famous chef never felt that washing dishes with his staff was [[beneath]] him.
senses.example_zh: 那位名廚從不覺得和員工一起洗碗有失他的身分。

senses.en: to cause a feeling or situation to develop
senses.pattern: breed distrust / breed violence / breed resentment / breed confidence
senses.example: Success achieved too easily can [[breed]] a dangerous sense of overconfidence in young athletes.
senses.example_zh: 太容易得來的成功，可能會在年輕運動員身上引起危險的過度自信。
senses.note: 過去式、過去分詞為 bred

senses.en: a particular type of person or thing
senses.pattern: a new breed of / a rare breed / a dying breed
senses.example: A new [[breed]] of young farmers is using drones and sensors to grow rice.
senses.example_zh: 有一種新類型的年輕農夫，正利用無人機和感測器來種稻。

gsat.sentence: This new [[breed]] of online classes is shaking up the higher education world in many ways.

senses.en: a hidden problem or disadvantage
senses.pattern: there's a catch / What's the catch? / the only catch is that
senses.example: The job pays well and offers long holidays, so I kept wondering what the [[catch]] was.
senses.example_zh: 這份工作薪水高、假期又長，所以我一直在想其中有什麼隱藏的問題。

senses.en: to manage to hear or understand what is said
senses.pattern: catch sb's name / didn't catch what sb said / catch the meaning
senses.example: The station was so noisy that I failed to [[catch]] the announcement about my train.
senses.example_zh: 車站太吵了，我沒聽清楚關於我那班火車的廣播。

senses.en: the amount of fish caught
senses.pattern: the day's catch / a good catch / the fish catch
senses.example: The fishermen returned to port at dawn and sold their entire [[catch]] within an hour.
senses.example_zh: 漁夫在黎明時回港，一小時內就把全部漁獲賣光了。

gsat.sentence: Jane: I'm sorry, I didn't [[catch]] your last name.
Iceland has increased their fish [[catch]] by 30% in the last 20 years.

senses.en: the number of copies a newspaper or magazine sells
senses.pattern: a daily circulation of / a wide circulation / circulation figures
senses.example: The local newspaper has a daily [[circulation]] of fifty thousand, mostly among older readers.
senses.example_zh: 這家地方報紙的每日發行量為五萬份，讀者大多是年長者。

senses.en: the passing of money or goods from person to person
senses.pattern: in circulation / out of circulation / put into circulation
senses.example: The old paper notes were taken out of [[circulation]] and replaced with plastic ones.
senses.example_zh: 舊的紙鈔已停止流通，改由塑膠鈔票取代。

senses.en: to promise or give yourself fully to something
senses.pattern: be committed to + N/V-ing / commit oneself to / commit to a plan
senses.example: The city has [[committed]] itself to cutting plastic waste in half within ten years.
senses.example_zh: 該市承諾在十年內將塑膠垃圾減半。
senses.note: to 為介系詞，後接名詞或 V-ing

senses.en: to use money, time, or people for a purpose
senses.pattern: commit money to / commit resources to / commit time to
senses.example: The company will [[commit]] half of its annual budget to developing cleaner engines.
senses.example_zh: 該公司將把年度預算的一半投入研發更乾淨的引擎。

gsat.sentence: They are [[committed]] to glorifying their parents.
The non-profit organization has [[committed]] $1 million over five years to finance the construction of the medical center.

senses.en: a person you know who can help you
senses.pattern: business contacts / have contacts in / a useful contact / build up contacts
senses.example: Thanks to her [[contacts]] in the publishing industry, her first novel came out within months.
senses.example_zh: 多虧她在出版界的人脈，她的第一本小說幾個月內就出版了。

senses.en: small lenses worn on the eyes; contact lenses
senses.pattern: wear contacts / put in one's contacts / take out one's contacts
senses.example: He forgot to take out his [[contacts]] before swimming, and his eyes hurt all evening.
senses.example_zh: 他游泳前忘了取下隱形眼鏡，眼睛痛了一整晚。
senses.note: 口語用法，常用複數；即 contact lenses

senses.en: to cut off the edges of a picture
senses.pattern: crop a photo / crop an image / crop sb out of the picture
senses.example: She [[cropped]] the photo so that the strangers in the background could not be seen.
senses.example_zh: 她裁切了照片，好讓背景裡的陌生人不被看到。
senses.note: crop up 指（問題）突然出現

senses.en: a group of people or things appearing together
senses.pattern: a new crop of / this year's crop of / a crop of young players
senses.example: This year's [[crop]] of first-year students seems more interested in coding than in sports.
senses.example_zh: 今年這一批新生似乎對寫程式比對運動更有興趣。

gsat.sentence: He made clear his dislike of images that had been improved by artificial light, darkroom effects, and even [[cropping]].

senses.en: a method used to produce a particular effect
senses.pattern: a literary device / a rhetorical device / a marketing device / a plot device
senses.example: Repeating a key phrase is a simple [[device]] that speakers use to make their message stick.
senses.example_zh: 重複關鍵語句是演講者用來讓訊息深植人心的簡單手法。

gsat.sentence: Many women report that the henna crowns really work as a healing [[device]], helping them build a more positive self-image at a time when they are vulnerable and depressed.

senses.en: to stop doing, studying, or discussing something
senses.pattern: drop a plan / drop a course / drop the subject / drop the charges
senses.example: The committee decided to [[drop]] the proposal after most parents strongly objected to it.
senses.example_zh: 在多數家長強烈反對後，委員會決定放棄這項提案。

senses.en: to leave someone out of a team or group
senses.pattern: drop sb from the team / be dropped from the list / be dropped for the final
senses.example: After missing three practices in a row, the striker was [[dropped]] from the school team.
senses.example_zh: 連續缺席三次練習後，那名前鋒被校隊除名。

gsat.sentence: Deemed a public hazard, the project was immediately [[dropped]], and traffic lights were banned until their return in 1929 back to the British streets.

senses.en: to have people as guests and give them food
senses.pattern: entertain guests / entertain clients / entertain friends at home
senses.example: My grandparents love to [[entertain]] relatives at home with a big dinner every Lunar New Year.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父母喜歡每年農曆新年在家準備豐盛的晚餐款待親戚。

senses.en: to consider or keep an idea, hope, or doubt
senses.pattern: entertain an idea / entertain a hope / entertain doubts / entertain the possibility
senses.example: The manager refused to even [[entertain]] the idea of closing the store on weekends.
senses.example_zh: 經理甚至拒絕考慮週末不營業的想法。

senses.en: to decide or set a date, time, or price
senses.pattern: fix a date / fix a time / fix a price / at a fixed price
senses.example: The two schools have not yet [[fixed]] a date for the friendly basketball game.
senses.example_zh: 兩校尚未確定籃球友誼賽的日期。

senses.en: to prepare a meal or a drink
senses.pattern: fix dinner / fix sb a drink / fix a sandwich
senses.example: Dad offered to [[fix]] us some sandwiches before we left for the long hike.
senses.example_zh: 爸爸提議在我們出發去長途健行前，幫我們準備一些三明治。
senses.note: 主要為美式口語用法

senses.en: to direct your eyes or attention steadily at something
senses.pattern: fix one's eyes on / fix one's gaze on / fix one's attention on
senses.example: The little boy [[fixed]] his eyes on the magician's hands, trying to discover the trick.
senses.example_zh: 小男孩把目光集中在魔術師的手上，想找出其中的訣竅。

gsat.sentence: Another child said dieting meant “you [[fix]] food but you don’t eat it.”
It is more polite to [[fix]] your eyes on him/her as long as you can.

senses.en: (of a person or face) to become red
senses.pattern: flush with embarrassment / flush with anger / flush bright red
senses.example: Her face [[flushed]] with embarrassment when the teacher read her poem aloud to the whole class.
senses.example_zh: 老師當著全班的面朗讀她的詩時，她尷尬得臉紅了。
senses.note: 名詞 flush 指臉上的紅暈

senses.en: the good results of work or effort
senses.pattern: bear fruit / the fruits of one's labor / the fruit of years of research
senses.example: After years of practice, her efforts finally bore [[fruit]] when she won the national contest.
senses.example_zh: 經過多年練習，她的努力終於有了成果，贏得了全國比賽。
senses.note: bear fruit 指「有成果、奏效」

senses.en: to keep a feeling or thought in mind for long
senses.pattern: harbor a grudge / harbor doubts / harbor resentment / harbor hopes
senses.example: Although he apologized, she still [[harbored]] doubts about whether he had told the truth.
senses.example_zh: 雖然他道了歉，她仍心懷疑慮，不確定他是否說了實話。

senses.en: to hide and protect someone, especially a criminal
senses.pattern: harbor a criminal / harbor a fugitive / harbor refugees
senses.example: The farmer was arrested for [[harboring]] two escaped prisoners in his barn for a week.
senses.example_zh: 那名農夫因在穀倉窩藏兩名逃犯一週而被捕。
senses.note: 亦指藏有（病菌）：harbor bacteria

senses.en: bad or harmful
senses.pattern: ill effects / ill will / ill feeling / ill fortune
senses.example: Fortunately, the children suffered no [[ill]] effects from drinking the dirty water.
senses.example_zh: 幸好孩子們喝了髒水後，並未出現任何不良的影響。
senses.note: 複數名詞 ills 指弊病，如 social ills

senses.en: badly; hardly
senses.pattern: can ill afford / speak ill of / ill-treated / ill-prepared
senses.example: With exams only a week away, we can [[ill]] afford to waste another evening.
senses.example_zh: 離考試只剩一週，我們幾乎不能再浪費任何一個晚上了。
senses.note: 常構成複合字，如 ill-treat、ill-timed

senses.en: to describe or name someone or something in a particular way
senses.pattern: label sb (as) a troublemaker / be labeled lazy / be labeled as a failure
senses.example: Students who ask many questions should not be [[labeled]] as troublemakers by their teachers.
senses.example_zh: 愛發問的學生不該被老師歸類為麻煩製造者。
senses.note: 多用被動，常帶負面意味

senses.en: a company that makes fashion goods; its brand name
senses.pattern: a designer label / a fashion label / her own label / a luxury label
senses.example: After years of designing for others, she launched her own fashion [[label]] in Paris.
senses.example_zh: 替別人設計多年後，她在巴黎創立了自己的時裝品牌。
senses.note: record label 指唱片公司

gsat.sentence: For example, the 14th typhoon in 2003 can be [[labeled]] either as Typhoon 0314 or Typhoon 200314.

senses.en: to form rows along the sides of something
senses.pattern: line the streets / be lined with trees / line the route
senses.example: Thousands of fans [[lined]] the streets to welcome the baseball team home.
senses.example_zh: 數千名球迷沿街排列，歡迎棒球隊凱旋歸來。

senses.en: a type of work or business
senses.pattern: line of work / line of business / What line of work are you in?
senses.example: In her [[line]] of work, staying calm under pressure matters more than speed.
senses.example_zh: 在她這個行業，在壓力下保持冷靜比速度更重要。

senses.en: the words an actor speaks in a play or film
senses.pattern: learn one's lines / forget one's lines / deliver a line
senses.example: The young actor forgot his [[lines]] halfway through the play and had to improvise.
senses.example_zh: 那位年輕演員戲演到一半忘了台詞，只好即興發揮。
senses.note: 常用複數

gsat.sentence: Public dwellings [[lined]] its ground level; a marketplace and two mosques also fit comfortably inside.
In this [[line]] of work, the person is paid to do daring actions that are deemed too risky for the regular actor to perform, including jumping from heights, crashing cars, or fighting with weapons.

senses.en: to be as good as someone or something
senses.pattern: cannot match / match sb for sth / no one can match her / match the quality of
senses.example: No other bakery in town can [[match]] this shop for the freshness of its bread.
senses.example_zh: 論麵包的新鮮度，鎮上沒有別家麵包店比得上這家店。

senses.en: a person equal to another in strength or skill
senses.pattern: be no match for / meet one's match / be more than a match for
senses.example: The young chess player was no [[match]] for the champion and lost in twenty moves.
senses.example_zh: 那位年輕棋手不是冠軍的對手，二十步就輸了。

gsat.sentence: However, they cannot [[match]] the personal attention coming from the distinctive tap of a pea shooter.

senses.en: a formal proposal discussed and voted on at a meeting
senses.pattern: propose a motion / pass a motion / second a motion / reject a motion
senses.example: The student council passed a [[motion]] to extend library hours during exam week.
senses.example_zh: 學生會通過了一項在考試週延長圖書館開放時間的動議。

senses.en: to signal to someone with your hand or head
senses.pattern: motion (for) sb to do sth / motion to sb / motion sb to a seat
senses.example: The librarian [[motioned]] for us to lower our voices and pointed at the sign.
senses.example_zh: 圖書館員打手勢示意我們降低音量，並指了指告示。

senses.en: to care for a sick person or an injury
senses.pattern: nurse sb back to health / nurse an injury / nurse a cold
senses.example: She stayed home for a week to [[nurse]] her grandfather back to health after his surgery.
senses.example_zh: 她在家待了一週，照料手術後的祖父直到他康復。
senses.note: 亦指哺乳，如 nursing mothers

senses.en: to hold a feeling or hope for a long time
senses.pattern: nurse a grudge / nurse a hope / nurse an ambition
senses.example: For years he [[nursed]] a secret hope of becoming a pilot despite his poor eyesight.
senses.example_zh: 儘管視力不佳，多年來他一直心懷成為飛行員的祕密希望。

senses.en: (of money) not yet paid
senses.pattern: an outstanding debt / an outstanding balance / outstanding bills / outstanding loans
senses.example: He used his year-end bonus to pay off the [[outstanding]] debt on his motorcycle.
senses.example_zh: 他用年終獎金還清了機車尚未付清的欠款。

senses.en: not yet done, solved, or dealt with
senses.pattern: outstanding issues / outstanding problems / outstanding work
senses.example: The two sides will meet again next week to discuss several [[outstanding]] issues.
senses.example_zh: 雙方下週將再次會面，討論幾個尚未解決的問題。

senses.en: to make something as good as possible
senses.pattern: perfect a skill / perfect a technique / perfect one's English
senses.example: The young pianist spent the whole summer [[perfecting]] a difficult piece for the competition.
senses.example_zh: 那位年輕鋼琴家花了整個夏天，為比賽把一首高難度的曲子練到完美。
senses.note: 動詞讀作 /pɚˈfɛkt/，重音在第二音節

senses.en: complete; total
senses.pattern: a perfect stranger / perfect nonsense / with perfect seriousness
senses.example: A [[perfect]] stranger returned my lost wallet without taking a single dollar from it.
senses.example_zh: 一位完全陌生的人把我遺失的錢包還給我，裡面一塊錢也沒少。

gsat.sentence: Understanding how to [[perfect]] your nap is vital for reaping its benefits.
Many folk tales are also tall tales—stories of unbelievable events told with [[perfect]] seriousness.

senses.en: a written contract of insurance
senses.pattern: an insurance policy / take out a policy / renew a policy
senses.example: Read your travel insurance [[policy]] carefully to find out whether it covers lost luggage.
senses.example_zh: 請仔細閱讀你的旅遊保險單，看看行李遺失是否在理賠範圍內。

senses.en: a mark left on a surface by something pressed
senses.pattern: leave prints / paw prints / take sb's prints / a set of prints
senses.example: The thief wore gloves so that he would not leave any [[prints]] on the window.
senses.example_zh: 小偷戴著手套，以免在窗戶上留下任何指紋。
senses.note: 常見複合字：fingerprint、footprint

senses.en: to write in separate letters, not joined ones
senses.pattern: print one's name / please print clearly / print in capital letters
senses.example: Please [[print]] your full name in capital letters at the top of the form.
senses.example_zh: 請在表格上方以正楷（印刷體）大寫字母書寫你的全名。
senses.note: the fine print 指合約中的細則

senses.en: a period of three months, especially in business
senses.pattern: the first quarter / next quarter / profits for the quarter
senses.example: The company's sales rose by ten percent in the third [[quarter]] of the year.
senses.example_zh: 該公司今年第三季的銷售額成長了百分之十。
senses.note: 形容詞、副詞為 quarterly（每季的）

senses.en: a district of a town or city
senses.pattern: the old quarter / the historic quarter / a residential quarter
senses.example: Tourists love to wander through the old [[quarter]] of the city, with its narrow stone streets.
senses.example_zh: 遊客喜歡漫步於這座城市的舊城區，那裡有狹窄的石板街道。
senses.note: 複數 quarters 指宿舍、住處

gsat.sentence: If all the manufacturers can hang on during this financial crisis, the economy may get better next [[quarter]].

senses.en: to tell a story or describe events
senses.pattern: relate a story / relate one's experience / relate what happened
senses.example: At the reunion, Grandpa [[related]] how he had crossed the mountains on foot as a boy.
senses.example_zh: 在聚會上，爺爺講述了他小時候如何徒步翻越群山。

senses.en: to understand and feel sympathy for someone
senses.pattern: relate to sb / relate to a character / I can relate to that
senses.example: Many teenagers [[relate]] to the main character because she also struggles to fit in.
senses.example_zh: 許多青少年對主角產生共鳴，因為她也很難融入群體。
senses.note: 與 to 連用

senses.en: empty space that can be used for something
senses.pattern: make room for / take up room / leave room for / room for one more
senses.example: We moved the sofa against the wall to make [[room]] for the new bookshelf.
senses.example_zh: 我們把沙發移到牆邊，好騰出空間放新書架。
senses.note: 作此義時為不可數名詞

senses.en: the chance for something to happen or be done
senses.pattern: room for improvement / room for doubt / no room for error
senses.example: Your essay is well organized, but there is still [[room]] for improvement in grammar.
senses.example_zh: 你的作文組織得很好，但文法仍有改進的餘地。

senses.en: to formally support a proposal at a meeting
senses.pattern: second a motion / second a proposal / I'll second that
senses.example: When no one offered to [[second]] the motion, the chairperson moved on to the next item.
senses.example_zh: 沒有人附議這項動議，主席便接著討論下一個議題。

senses.en: a dangerous medical condition after serious injury
senses.pattern: go into shock / be in shock / be treated for shock
senses.example: The injured driver had lost so much blood that he went into [[shock]] in the ambulance.
senses.example_zh: 受傷的駕駛失血過多，在救護車上就休克了。
senses.note: 作此義時為不可數名詞

senses.en: neat and stylish in appearance
senses.pattern: look smart / a smart suit / smart clothes / a smart restaurant
senses.example: He looked very [[smart]] in his new suit at his sister's wedding.
senses.example_zh: 他在姊姊的婚禮上穿著新西裝，看起來非常體面。
senses.note: 主要為英式用法

senses.en: to feel a sharp stinging pain or feel upset
senses.pattern: eyes smart / smart from the smoke / be smarting from a defeat
senses.example: Her eyes began to [[smart]] as soon as she started chopping the onions.
senses.example_zh: 她一開始切洋蔥，眼睛就感到刺痛。

senses.en: a person's mood or state of mind
senses.pattern: in high spirits / in low spirits / lift sb's spirits / raise sb's spirits
senses.example: The whole class was in high [[spirits]] after winning the school singing contest.
senses.example_zh: 贏得校內歌唱比賽後，全班情緒十分高昂。
senses.note: 作此義時用複數

senses.en: strong alcoholic drink such as whisky
senses.pattern: wine and spirits / a tax on spirits / a bottle of spirits
senses.example: The restaurant serves beer and wine but does not sell [[spirits]] such as whisky.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳供應啤酒和葡萄酒，但不賣威士忌之類的烈酒。

senses.en: a ghost or the soul of a dead person
senses.pattern: evil spirits / the spirits of the dead / ancestral spirits / drive away spirits
senses.example: Villagers once set off firecrackers at midnight to drive evil [[spirits]] away from their homes.
senses.example_zh: 村民從前會在午夜放鞭炮，把邪惡的鬼魂趕出家門。

gsat.sentence: Surprisingly, the audience listened with full focus and high [[spirits]].
Obon, or the Bon Festival, is a Japanese holiday that honors the [[spirits]] of the dead.

senses.en: a floor or level of a building
senses.pattern: a two-story house / a ten-story building / the top story
senses.example: The fire started on the third [[story]] of the building and spread quickly to the roof.
senses.example_zh: 火勢從這棟大樓的第三層樓竄起，並迅速蔓延到屋頂。
senses.note: 英式拼法為 storey

senses.en: a report in a newspaper or news broadcast
senses.pattern: a news story / a front-page story / cover a story / run a story
senses.example: The reporter flew to the island to cover a [[story]] about the damage caused by the typhoon.
senses.example_zh: 記者飛往那座島，採訪一則有關颱風災情的新聞報導。

senses.en: a person of higher rank or position
senses.pattern: one's immediate superior / report to a superior / obey one's superiors
senses.example: Before making such a big decision, you had better discuss it with your [[superior]].
senses.example_zh: 做這麼重大的決定之前，你最好先和上司討論。

senses.en: acting as if you are better than others
senses.pattern: a superior smile / a superior tone / a superior attitude / act superior
senses.example: His [[superior]] tone made the new members feel that their opinions did not matter.
senses.example_zh: 他高傲的語氣讓新成員覺得自己的意見無足輕重。

senses.en: a fixed period of time that something lasts
senses.pattern: a term of office / a four-year term / serve a second term / a prison term
senses.example: The club president is elected for a [[term]] of one year and may run again.
senses.example_zh: 社長的任期為一年，期滿後可再次參選。

senses.en: the conditions of an agreement
senses.pattern: terms and conditions / the terms of a contract / under the terms of / agree to the terms
senses.example: Read the [[terms]] of the contract carefully before you sign it, especially those about refunds.
senses.example_zh: 簽約前請仔細閱讀合約的條款，尤其是與退費有關的部分。
senses.note: 作此義時用複數

senses.en: to give a particular name to something
senses.pattern: be termed + N/adj. / what is termed / term sth a success
senses.example: Psychologists [[term]] this common habit of putting off important tasks procrastination.
senses.example_zh: 心理學家把這種拖延重要事務的常見習慣稱為拖延症。
senses.note: 常用被動：be termed …

gsat.sentence: However, their demand is high because many people buy them to tell the world that they have money, [[termed]] as conspicuous consumption in economics.

senses.en: to be losing in a game or contest
senses.pattern: trail by two points / trail the leader / trail 0–2 / trail in the polls
senses.example: With only one lap left, the young runner still [[trailed]] the leader by three seconds.
senses.example_zh: 只剩最後一圈時，那位年輕跑者仍落後領先者三秒。
senses.note: 亦指拖曳、跟在後面：trail behind

senses.en: a series of marks or signs left behind
senses.pattern: leave a trail / a trail of blood / follow a trail / on the trail of
senses.example: The puppy ran through the house, leaving a [[trail]] of muddy footprints on the floor.
senses.example_zh: 小狗跑過屋子，在地板上留下一道泥腳印的痕跡。

gsat.sentence: They travel entirely along tree branches and vines, laying down [[trails]] of pheromone (a chemical substance) behind them so that other ants can follow.

senses.en: to think about something in a particular way
senses.pattern: view A as B / be viewed as / view sth with suspicion / view sth differently
senses.example: Many young people [[view]] failure as a valuable lesson rather than something to fear.
senses.example_zh: 許多年輕人把失敗視為寶貴的一課，而不是可怕的事。

senses.en: to look at or watch something carefully
senses.pattern: view an exhibition / view a film / view a house / view sth online
senses.example: Thousands of visitors gathered on the hill to [[view]] the eclipse through special glasses.
senses.example_zh: 數千名遊客聚集在山丘上，透過特殊眼鏡觀看日食。
senses.note: in view of 表「鑑於」

gsat.sentence: The cactus’s thick outer layer (i.e., husk), with all those spines, had always been [[viewed]] as a waste product until researchers developed a biogas generator to turn the husks into electricity.
People who are more sensitive to anxiety can panic after [[viewing]] a thriller.

senses.en: (of a road or river) to curve and bend repeatedly
senses.pattern: wind through / wind along / wind its way / a winding road
senses.example: The river [[winds]] across the plain like a silver ribbon before it finally reaches the sea.
senses.example_zh: 這條河像一條銀色緞帶蜿蜒流過平原，最後注入大海。
senses.note: 讀作 /waɪnd/，過去式、過去分詞為 wound

senses.en: to wrap something around; to tighten a clock's spring
senses.pattern: wind a bandage around / wind a scarf around / wind (up) a clock
senses.example: You should [[wind]] the bandage firmly around the ankle, but not so tightly that it hurts.
senses.example_zh: 你應該把繃帶牢牢纏繞在腳踝上，但不要緊到會痛。
senses.note: 讀作 /waɪnd/

gsat.sentence: In many old castles in Europe, visitors often find a fantastic spiral staircase, which provides a captivating focal point as it [[winds]] up the building.
Throughout the Middle Ages, [[winding]] staircases became a well-established feature of European castles, mainly for their advantages in helping to defend against attackers.

quiz.stem: Although Mia smiled and congratulated the winner, she secretly ______ deep anger toward the judges, who she believed had treated her unfairly.
quiz.explain_zh: harbor＝心懷（情緒）。Mia 表面上恭喜贏家，心裡卻對評審懷著怒氣。

quiz.stem: The online store offers a brand-new tablet for only one dollar, but the ______ is that buyers must pay for two years of expensive monthly service.
quiz.explain_zh: catch＝隱藏的問題、圈套。一元平板的代價是得綁兩年昂貴的月租。

quiz.stem: Students will not receive their graduation certificates until all ______ library fines and lab fees, some of which were due months ago, have been paid in full.
quiz.explain_zh: outstanding＝未付清的。學生須繳清積欠的罰款與費用才能領畢業證書。

quiz.stem: From the visitor center, a narrow mountain road ______ through thick bamboo forests for ten kilometers before reaching the hot spring village.
quiz.explain_zh: wind＝蜿蜒。山路蜿蜒穿過竹林十公里後，才抵達溫泉村。

quiz.stem: As more people read the news on their phones, the magazine's ______ has fallen from 80,000 copies a month to fewer than 20,000.
quiz.explain_zh: circulation＝發行量。大家改用手機看新聞，雜誌每月發行量大幅下滑。

quiz.stem: At the class meeting, Kevin proposed holding a charity sale, and since several classmates were quick to ______ the idea, it was put to a vote right away.
quiz.explain_zh: second＝附議、贊同。同學立刻附議 Kevin 的義賣提案，於是馬上表決。

quiz.stem: The proud manager considered it ______ him to answer phones or serve coffee, so he always left such tasks to the newest employees.
quiz.explain_zh: beneath＝有失…的身分。高傲的經理認為接電話、倒咖啡有失身分。

quiz.stem: Under the ______ of the scholarship, students must keep an average grade of 85 or above and complete 40 hours of community service each year.
quiz.explain_zh: term＝（複數）條款、條件。依獎學金的條款，學生須維持成績並做社區服務。

quiz.stem: Though ______ by two goals at halftime, the home team refused to give up and scored three times in the final fifteen minutes.
quiz.explain_zh: trail＝（比賽中）落後。主隊中場落後兩球，最後十五分鐘連進三球逆轉。

quiz.stem: A lack of honest communication between parents and teenagers tends to ______ misunderstanding and distrust within a family, making small problems much harder to solve.
quiz.explain_zh: breed＝引起、釀成。親子間缺乏坦誠溝通，容易造成家中的誤解與不信任。
